subject: Verdant Analytics - Evaluation materials, mutual action timeline, and decommission plan
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia@verdantanalytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Eval dataset + MAP + proposed close window

Hi Connor / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Verdant is excited to validate Redwood against three core workflows (topic extraction, intent classification, and refund routing). Before we spin up the sandbox, can you send the evaluation materials and a proposed MAP so we can align on milestones and compliance constraints?

Key asks from our side:
- A zip with test cases and prompt packs (we run in-house on our staging cluster).
- Clear usage guardrails: retention period, redistribution policy, and required logs/artifacts to show deletion.
- An acceptance checklist (how we determine pass/fail for the PoC).
- A high-level close timeline (targeting contract signature by Nov 12).

Two items to flag: our legal team prefers a 60-day maximum retention for shared datasets and requires checksum/proof that any PII is redacted. We can share an internal MPA template if that helps.

Thanks — cc'ing Ethan (ops) who will own the run.

Best,
Olivia Park
Director, ML Ops
Verdant Analytics

---

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@verdantanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Eval dataset + MAP + proposed close window

Hi Olivia — thanks, and glad the demo was useful. I've attached an evaluation bundle and a draft MAP we typically use for exchanges like this. Highlights up front:

- Attachment: verdant_eval_pack_v2.zip (contains prompt packs, ~600 curated testcases, README, sample harness)
- Attachment: redwood-MAP-v1.2.pdf (mutual action plan with milestones and sign-off points)

Usage constraints we require for shared eval materials:
1) No redistribution outside Verdant Analytics internal evaluation team.
2) Delete all copies (including backups) after the agreed retention window; we typically ask for 90 days but will consider 60 with audit logs.
3) Watermarked filenames and embedded case IDs for traceability; do not publish outputs.
4) Provide a SHA256 checksum and confirmation of PII masking; we'll include a small script to verify.

Proposed MAP summary (high level):
- Week 0 (Oct 12): Materials delivered + environment setup
- Week 1-2: Run tests, run acceptance harness (Redwood SE will assist)
- Week 3: Feedback + minor retests
- Week 4: Acceptance review and go/no-go

Target close: Nov 12 (aligns with your ask). If Verdant needs a shorter retention, we can accept 60 days conditional on retained audit logs (S3 object lifecycle + deletion receipts).

Next steps:
- Please confirm who will sign the data transfer terms. I'll send a DocuSign link for the MAP + Data Transfer Addendum once we align edits.

Attachments: [Attachment: verdant_eval_pack_v2.zip (52MB)], [Attachment: redwood-MAP-v1.2.pdf (220KB)]

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com

---

From: Olivia Park <olivia@verdantanalytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Marsh <ethan@verdantanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Eval dataset + MAP + proposed close window

Connor — got the bundle, thanks. Quick questions after a fast pass through the ZIP: 

1) Can you provide a short manifest with the SHA256 checksums for each file in the bundle so our security team can verify integrity on receipt?
2) The prompt packs reference some live customer utterances — has Verdant protected customer PII in those samples? We need confirmation on redaction approach (token-level masking vs synthetic substitution).
3) On the 60 vs 90-day retention: our legal will insist on 60, but we can accept an exception to 90 if Redwood keeps deletion receipts and audit logs for 120 days. Is that acceptable?

Also — we prefer the acceptance criteria to include a small set of deterministic testcases (10 seed examples) with exact expected outputs so our SQA can run automated regression checks. Can you cut a deterministic seed subset?

If we can close these points this week, we'll route the MAP + NDA to our VP of Legal.

Thanks,
Olivia

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@verdantanalytics.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Eval dataset + MAP + proposed close window

Hi Olivia — Marissa on the SE side. A few technical clarifications and an offer to help run the acceptance harness: 

- Checksum manifest: included as verdant_eval_pack_v2_checksums.txt in the ZIP. Each file has a SHA256 entry.
- PII: The pack uses a two-step sanitization: regex-based redaction for obvious identifiers and light synthetic substitution for context where semantics matter (e.g., replacing names with labeled tokens). We keep a small internal mapping only for debugging and will not share that mapping. The README notes the scrub policy and a small script (verify_masking.py) that flags leftover patterns.
- Deterministic seed subset: attached a folder seeds/ with 12 deterministic cases and expected outputs (seed-01..seed-12). Those are intended for regression checks — please treat them as sensitive.
- Evaluation harness: we provide a Dockerfile + run script (run_eval.sh) that executes the harness against your cluster; it emits an artifacts.tar.gz with logs and deletion receipts after cleanup.

On retention: we can accept 60 days on the condition Redwood retains deletion receipts and audit logs for 120 days and can provide those receipts on request. Audit logs will include S3 object deletion events, user id, and timestamp.

If you want, we can schedule a short runbook call tomorrow (30 minutes) to walk your ops team through the harness and expected artifacts.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment references: [Attachment: verdant_eval_pack_v2_checksums.txt (2KB)], [Attachment: seeds/seed-01..seed-12.json (approx 6KB total)], [Attachment: run_eval.sh (1.2KB)]

---

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@verdantanalytics.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Eval dataset + MAP + proposed close window

Hi Olivia — Rafael on Legal/Customer Success. A couple legal/operational notes so we can avoid last-minute redlines: 

1) Data transfer addendum: we'll send a short DocuSign packet that combines the MAP + Data Transfer Addendum + a one-paragraph MPA clause with the usage constraints you requested. Please review before routing to Verdant legal.
2) Retention and proof of deletion: Redwood can provide deletion receipts (S3 event + actor) for 120 days. We cannot retain raw copies of the dataset beyond the agreed retention window. To satisfy your audit, we can provide a signed attestation plus the deletion receipts.
3) Escrow/escrowed escrow: if Verdant requires escrow of a small seed subset for dispute resolution, we can agree to hold a hashed-only escrow (we keep SHA256 hashes and a notarized timestamped record) — not the plaintext.

If Verdant concurs on the hashed escrow approach and the deletion-receipt flow, Legal can deliver the DocuSign packet today. We suggest the signers be:
- Verdant: VP Legal (signature)
- Redwood: Head of Enterprise Sales (signature)

I'll include a short clause defining acceptance criteria: "Acceptance requires passing the deterministic seed subset with no more than 5% divergence on classification labels and exact match on the deterministic seeds." That should give the SQA a clear pass/fail gate.

Rafael Mendes
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com

Attachment: [Attachment: verdant-dataprotection-ack.txt (1KB)]

---

From: Olivia Park <olivia@verdantanalytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Marsh <ethan@verdantanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Eval dataset + MAP + proposed close window

Team — all good from our side with the proposed approach. Quick confirms: 
- Verdant will sign the DocuSign packet (VP Legal) once you send it. Please include the hashed-escrow clause and the deletion-receipt commitment.
- We accept the 60-day retention on condition Redwood retains deletion receipts for 120 days.
- We'll treat the seeds/ folder as restricted; SQA will run deterministic seeds and report via the artifacts.tar.gz.
- Timeline: we aim to start the run on Monday Oct 19, 2026 and target acceptance review by Nov 9, 2026 to keep Nov 12 close realistic.

Final asks before we route legal: can you send the DocuSign packet and a short checklist of environment variables + CPU/GPU recommendations for the run? Also — please include the checksum manifest file separately in the DocuSign packet or a link so our security team can pull it securely.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Director, ML Ops, Verdant Analytics
